ep1.blocker: Both the initial request and the sole allowed retry failed during installed Harbor package import before the Ray gang formed. harbor expected TelemetryConfig from harbor_config, but the installed harbor_config did not export it.

ep8.reason: The sequential protocol could no longer yield a passing comparison after EP1 exhausted its retry without an accepted update. Submitting EP8 would spend 80 H100 without changing the frozen blocked/incomplete disposition.

results.decision_rule_evaluation: Blocked/incomplete: neither arm completed accepted optimizer updates through step 9, so no numerical EP8-versus-EP1 claim is supported.

disposition.training_claim: No accepted 67B optimizer update was observed, so this qualification supports no full-workload stability or divergence claim.
disposition.component_claim: The earlier component oracle remains valid and unchanged; this infrastructure result neither strengthens nor weakens its narrow expert-gradient scaling conclusion.
disposition.smallest_next_question: Restore a compatible harbor and harbor_config pair in the pinned standard task environment, prove that the pinned image imports the training entrypoint with a cheap one-task preflight, then rerun the already frozen two-arm protocol from EP1.

reviewers.verdict: Terminal disposition correct; one material process gap that does not change it.
reviewers.finding: The component oracle used a different image and standalone entrypoint, while the local dry-runs never exercised the pinned training container. A cheap one-task import preflight would have exposed the deterministic Harbor package mismatch before either full-gang EP1 submission.

applied_findings: The handoff now requires a cheap one-task import preflight in the exact pinned training image before another full-gang request. No production, test, or frozen-protocol change is warranted.
